sources.entry: EasyWI - Easy-Wi is a Web-interface that allows you to manage server daemons like gameservers. In addition it provides you with a CMS which includes a fully automated game- and voiceserver lending service. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Shell

summary.one_liner: Easy-WI is a web interface for managing game and voice server daemons, plus a CMS with an automated game- and voiceserver lending service.
summary.what_it_does: Easy-WI is a PHP-based web interface for managing server daemons such as game servers. It bundles a CMS that includes a fully automated game- and voiceserver lending service. The README says the goal is to automate as much administration as possible. Gameserver deployment to individual servers is described as largely automated once add-ons are updated on a central image server. It also covers TS3 voice servers and TSDNS, monitoring of game and voice servers (for example offline servers or missing passwords, which it says it corrects), and importing existing servers. Reseller accounts and a REST API for integration with shop systems such as WHMCS or Magento are mentioned. The interface uses Bootstrap for mobile use and supports English, Danish, Italian and German.
use_cases: manage game servers from a web interface
rent out game or voice servers to customers automatically
run a hosting business for gameservers
monitor and auto-correct game server settings
integrate server provisioning with a shop system via REST API
notable: Automated game- and voiceserver lending service built into a CMS
Deploys gameservers to individual hosts from a central image server
Monitoring that corrects offline servers, slot counts, passwords and branding
REST API so shop systems such as WHMCS or Magento can drive it
Reseller accounts and multilingual XML-based text
caveats: The gameserver module requires sudo, cron, proftpd and a bash shell at the game root
The voice module works best with a Linux-based TS3 server
The README does not include install or run instructions; it links to a separate installer
